name: f35_ducted_quad
decisions: ACK arm_stiffness: first flights on a PETG frame (first mode ~125 Hz, deflection 0.3 mm); switch to PETG-CF (~176 Hz) or 3 mm carbon from frame.dxf (~194 Hz) if the gyro trace is noisy

ACK power_connector: full-throttle bursts (~32 A estimated) last a few seconds; hover draws ~5 A. XT30 is the usual connector on 3S 450-650 mAh packs; switch to a pack with an XT60 if the plug gets hot
